title: Chameleon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dff8c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2dcc4a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a0ffb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#38d858'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail curling -->
  <path d='M 30 62 Q 14 58 12 48 Q 10 38 18 34 Q 26 30 30 38 Q 34 46 26 48 Q 20 50 20 44' fill='none' stroke='#3ad45e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 30 62 Q 14 58 12 48 Q 10 38 18 34 Q 26 30 30 38 Q 34 46 26 48 Q 20 50 20 44' fill='none' stroke='#8dff9a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M 38 68 Q 34 80 28 84' fill='none' stroke='#2bbf48' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#3ad45e'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='85' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#8dff9a'/>

  <!-- front leg (dancing raised) -->
  <path d='M 60 64 Q 70 58 76 50' fill='none' stroke='#2bbf48' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='48' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3ad45e' transform='rotate(-30 78 48)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8dff9a' transform='rotate(-30 78 48)'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='24' ry='16' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- spines on back -->
  <polygon points='30,42 33,38 36,43' fill='#5ee878'/>
  <polygon points='38,41 41,36 44,41' fill='#5ee878'/>
  <polygon points='46,40 49,35 52,40' fill='#5ee878'/>
  <polygon points='54,41 57,37 60,42' fill='#5ee878'/>

  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='3' fill='#9dffa8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#9dffa8'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='2' fill='#9dffa8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='56' r='2' fill='#9dffa8'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='50' rx='14' ry='12' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>
  <!-- casque (crest) -->
  <path d='M 62 40 Q 68 30 76 38' fill='#4ee06a' stroke='#7dff8c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='5' fill='#1a8c33'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#0a3d14'/>
  <circle cx='73.5' cy='47' r='0.7' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M 74 55 Q 78 58 80 54' fill='none' stroke='#1a8c33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tongue flicking out happily -->
  <path d='M 80 53 Q 88 50 90 46' fill='none' stroke='#ff5e8a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ff5e8a'/>

  <!-- dancing motion lines -->
  <path d='M 22 30 Q 18 26 22 22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 84 30 Q 88 26 84 22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 14 70 Q 8 68 10 62' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- musical notes -->
  <path d='M 16 40 L 16 32 Q 20 30 20 34' fill='none' stroke='#ff9f43' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <path d='M 88 62 L 88 54 Q 92 52 92 56' fill='none' stroke='#ff9f43' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#ff9f43'/>
</svg>
